# Local Code Checks

> Free, open-source security and launch checkers that run in the browser (Pyodide; files are never uploaded), plus guides that explain real Supabase, Postgres, auth, webhook and AI agent security errors with tested fixes. Written by Abheesht Tripathi (backend engineering and AI security).

Each guide quotes the exact error message or risk, explains the cause, gives a step-by-step fix with SQL or code, and says how to verify it. Guide index: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/

## Guides: Supabase RLS and Storage

Hub page: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-rls/

- [Supabase “new row violates row-level security policy” – causes and fix](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-new-row-violates-row-level-security-policy/): Why Supabase returns 'new row violates row-level security policy' (42501) on insert, upsert or storage upload, and the exact policy that fixes each case.
- [Supabase “must be owner of table objects” – what it means and what to run instead](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-must-be-owner-of-table-objects/): Why 'must be owner of table objects' appears when you enable RLS or add policies on Supabase storage.objects, and the SQL statements that work instead.
- [Supabase “permission denied for table” – a missing GRANT, not a missing policy](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-permission-denied-for-table/): Why Supabase returns 'permission denied for table' (42501) for anon or signed-in users, the GRANT that fixes it, and why new tables need explicit grants.
- [Supabase “infinite recursion detected in policy for relation” – cause and fix](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-infinite-recursion-detected-in-policy/): Why 'infinite recursion detected in policy for relation' happens when an RLS policy queries its own table, and the security definer function that fixes it.
- [Supabase auth.uid() returns null – where it works, where it can't, and how to test policies](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-auth-uid-null-sql-editor/): Why auth.uid() is null in the Supabase SQL Editor, migrations, cron jobs and server code, how to test RLS as a real user, and how to pass the user's JWT.
- [Supabase “duplicate key value violates unique constraint” on upsert – the five causes](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-upsert-duplicate-key-violates-unique-constraint/): Why Supabase upsert and insert fail with 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint' (23505, 409): onConflict, missing unique index, out-of-sync sequences.
- [Supabase Realtime subscribed but no postgres_changes events – the checklist](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-realtime-not-receiving-changes/): Your Supabase Realtime channel says SUBSCRIBED but no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE events arrive. Check the publication, RLS, grants, filters and replica identity.
- [Supabase PGRST116 “Cannot coerce the result to a single JSON object” – .single() explained](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-pgrst116-cannot-coerce-single-json-object/): Why supabase-js .single() fails with PGRST116 'Cannot coerce the result to a single JSON object' (406), when to use maybeSingle(), and how RLS hides rows.
- [Supabase Storage “Object not found” (404) – when the file is really there](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-storage-object-not-found/): Why Supabase Storage returns 'Object not found' (404) from createSignedUrl or download when the file exists: wrong path, missing SELECT policy, anon client.
- [Slow Supabase queries with RLS – (select auth.uid()), indexes and the other fixes](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-rls-performance-auth-uid-select/): Fix the Supabase 'Auth RLS Initialization Plan' warning and slow RLS queries: (select auth.uid()), indexes on policy columns, roles and fewer policies.

## Guides: Auth, JWT and secrets

Hub page: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/auth-jwt/

- [Supabase “JWT expired” – why the token went stale and how to keep it fresh](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-jwt-expired/): Why Supabase API calls fail with 'JWT expired' (401), where stale access tokens come from in browser, server and mobile code, and how supabase-js refreshes.
- [Supabase service_role or secret key exposed in frontend code – detect, rotate, fix](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-service-role-key-exposed/): How to find a Supabase service_role or sb_secret_ key in your frontend bundle, why it bypasses every RLS policy, and how to rotate it and move code server-side.
- [Supabase “Database error deleting user” – the foreign key on auth.users](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-delete-user-violates-foreign-key-constraint/): Fix 'Database error deleting user' and 'violates foreign key constraint on table profiles' (23503) when deleting a Supabase auth user: ON DELETE rules.
- [Supabase “Email link is invalid or has expired” and confirmation links that open localhost](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-email-link-is-invalid-or-has-expired/): Why Supabase confirmation and magic links fail with otp_expired or redirect to localhost: Site URL, redirect allow list, link scanners and PKCE. Exact fixes.
- [redirect_uri_mismatch with Supabase Google or GitHub login – which URL goes where](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-oauth-redirect-uri-mismatch/): Fix 'Error 400: redirect_uri_mismatch' (Google) and 'The redirect_uri MUST match the registered callback URL' (GitHub) with Supabase Auth social login.
- [Supabase “Database error saving new user” – find the failing trigger and fix it](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-database-error-saving-new-user/): Why Supabase sign-up fails with 'Database error saving new user' (500): a broken handle_new_user trigger, search_path or a constraint. Find it and fix it.
- [A .env file or API key in Git history – rotate first, then rewrite history](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/leaked-env-secrets-git-history/): You pushed a .env file or API key to GitHub. Rotate the secrets first, then remove them from Git history with git-filter-repo, and block the next leak.

## Guides: Edge Functions, webhooks and APIs

Hub page: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/edge-functions/

- [Supabase Edge Function returns 404 NOT_FOUND on the CORS preflight](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-edge-function-404-not-found-cors-preflight/): The OPTIONS request to your Supabase Edge Function returns 404 NOT_FOUND and the browser reports CORS. Your CORS code never ran: how to find the real cause.
- [Supabase Edge Function 401 “Invalid JWT” or “Missing authorization header”](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-edge-function-401-invalid-jwt/): Why a Supabase Edge Function returns 401 'Invalid JWT' or 'Missing authorization header' before your code runs, and the fix for browsers, webhooks and cron.
- [Supabase Edge Function CORS errors from the browser – headers, preflight and error responses](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-edge-function-cors-header-not-allowed/): Fix 'Request header field x-client-info is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers' and other CORS errors when calling Supabase Edge Functions.
- [Supabase cron (pg_cron) job not running – a checklist with the SQL for each step](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-pg-cron-job-not-running/): Your Supabase cron job never runs or runs but does nothing. Check cron.job, job_run_details, the scheduler, UTC times and pg_net calls, with SQL.
- [Supabase Database Webhooks and pg_net requests that never arrive – how to debug them](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-database-webhook-pg-net-not-firing/): Supabase Database Webhook or pg_net call not reaching your Edge Function? Read net._http_response, fix 401s and timeouts, and handle missed events.
- [Stripe “No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload” – raw body and the right secret](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/stripe-webhook-no-signatures-found-matching-expected-signature/): Fix Stripe 'No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload' in Next.js, Express and Supabase Edge Functions: raw body, right secret, async.
- [Rate limiting an API route – return 429 Too Many Requests before abuse costs you](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/api-rate-limiting-429-too-many-requests/): Add rate limiting to a Next.js route, Express API or Supabase Edge Function: a Postgres fixed-window counter or Upstash Redis, 429 and Retry-After.
- [CORS “must not be the wildcard '*' when the request's credentials mode is 'include'” – the safe fix](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/cors-wildcard-origin-credentials-include/): Fix the CORS error 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin must not be the wildcard * when the request's credentials mode is include' without opening your API.

## Guides: Postgres errors and performance

Hub page: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-errors/

- [Postgres “new row for relation … violates check constraint” – find the rule and fix it](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-new-row-violates-check-constraint/): What 'new row for relation violates check constraint' (23514) means, how to see the rule that failed, and how to change a CHECK constraint safely.
- [“relation does not exist” in Postgres and Supabase – schema, quotes, search_path, cache](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-relation-does-not-exist/): Why Postgres says 'relation does not exist' (42P01) or Supabase says 'Could not find the table in the schema cache' (PGRST205) for a table you can see.
- [Supabase rpc “Could not find the function … in the schema cache” and “function does not exist”](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-rpc-could-not-find-function-schema-cache/): Fix PGRST202 'Could not find the function in the schema cache' and 42883 'function does not exist' when calling supabase.rpc(): names, types, overloads.
- [SECURITY DEFINER functions without a fixed search_path – the risk and the fix](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-security-definer-search-path/): What Supabase's 'Function Search Path Mutable' and 'Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function' warnings mean, the real risk, and the SQL that fixes both.
- [Supabase “too many connections” – Postgres slots, Supavisor limits and serverless pools](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-too-many-connections-supavisor/): Fix 'remaining connection slots are reserved', 'too many clients already' and Supavisor 'Max client connections reached' on Supabase: pooler modes, pool sizes.
- [Postgres “deadlock detected” (40P01) – read it, then remove the lock-order problem](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-deadlock-detected/): What Postgres 'deadlock detected' (40P01) means, how to read the DETAIL lines, and the fixes that stop it: one lock order, shorter transactions, retries.
- [Supabase “canceling statement due to statement timeout” (57014) – fix the query, then the limit](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/supabase-canceling-statement-due-to-statement-timeout/): Why Supabase queries fail with 'canceling statement due to statement timeout' (57014), the default limits per role, and how to fix the query before raising one.
- [Postgres “could not serialize access due to concurrent update” (40001) – retry or redesign](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/postgres-could-not-serialize-access-concurrent-update/): Why Postgres says 'could not serialize access due to concurrent update' (40001) under REPEATABLE READ or SERIALIZABLE, and how to retry or avoid it safely.

## Guides: AI agent and LLM app security

Hub page: https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/ai-security/

- [Prompt injection through retrieved documents (RAG) – what it is and how to contain it](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/rag-prompt-injection-retrieved-documents/): How instructions hidden in retrieved documents hijack a RAG chatbot (indirect prompt injection), and the layered fixes that actually limit the damage it can do.
- [LLM tool calls with over-broad permissions – a least-privilege pattern that holds](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/llm-tool-calling-least-privilege/): Why giving an LLM agent run_sql or an admin key is excessive agency (OWASP LLM06), and a least-privilege design with per-user auth, schemas and confirmations.
- [AI API keys and system prompts in frontend code – find them and move the call server-side](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/ai-api-key-system-prompt-exposed-frontend/): Why OpenAI or Anthropic keys and system prompts in VITE_ or NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables are public, how to find them in your bundle, and move AI calls server-side.
- [MCP server security basics – untrusted tool descriptions, local code and token scope](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/mcp-server-security-basics/): The real risks of MCP servers: local code you run, tool descriptions and results the model trusts, and over-scoped tokens. Rules for users and server authors.
- [LLM output rendered as HTML or run as SQL/shell – XSS and injection, and the safe patterns](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/llm-output-xss-sql-shell-injection/): Rendering LLM output with innerHTML or passing it to SQL or a shell is improper output handling (OWASP LLM05). How each attack works and the safe pattern.
- [SSRF through an AI agent's “fetch this URL” tool – how it happens and how to block it](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/ssrf-ai-agent-url-fetch-tool/): An AI agent's fetch_url tool can be steered to cloud metadata, localhost and internal services (SSRF). Validate the resolved IP, redirects and egress.
- [Indirect prompt injection in email and calendar agents – one message, full access](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/indirect-prompt-injection-email-calendar-agent/): How a single email or calendar invite can hijack an AI assistant that reads your inbox, and the controls that stop data leaving: tool gating, scopes, rendering.
- [Jailbreak vs prompt injection – the difference that decides your defences](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/jailbreak-vs-prompt-injection/): Jailbreaks and prompt injection are related but not the same. Who attacks, what breaks, and which defences in an LLM app actually address each one.
- [Per-user token quotas for an LLM endpoint – stop unbounded consumption (OWASP LLM10)](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/llm-api-per-user-quota-unbounded-consumption/): Stop one account from draining your OpenAI or Anthropic budget: a server-side key, daily per-user token quotas in Postgres, output caps and provider limits.
- [Audit logs for AI agent tool calls – record enough to answer “why did it do that?”](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/guides/ai-agent-tool-call-audit-log/): What to record for every AI agent tool call, how to keep the log append-only in Postgres, what to redact, and the queries that answer 'what did it do?'

## Checkers (run in the browser)

- [Supabase RLS checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/supabase-rls-checker/): Check Supabase migrations for tables without Row Level Security, using (true) policies, public buckets and service_role keys. Runs in your browser, no upload.
- [Firestore security rules checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/firestore-rules-checker/): Paste firestore.rules or storage.rules to find if true, test-mode rules, request.auth != null only checks and recursive wildcards. Runs locally in your browser.
- [Firebase Realtime Database public access check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/firebase-database-public-check/): Check database.rules.json for ".read": true, ".write": true, test-mode rules and auth != null only checks. Runs locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Exposed API key checker for NEXT_PUBLIC_ and VITE_ variables](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/exposed-api-key-checker/): Find secret keys in NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_ and EXPO_PUBLIC_ variables, hard-coded keys and built bundles. Runs in your browser; secrets never leave it.
- [Is your OpenAI API key exposed in the frontend?](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/openai-key-exposed-in-frontend/): Find OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini API keys used from browser code: dangerouslyAllowBrowser, VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_ keys. Runs in your browser.
- [Stripe webhook signature verification check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/stripe-webhook-signature-check/): Find Stripe webhook handlers that skip constructEvent, verify parsed JSON instead of the raw body, or ignore failures. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Razorpay webhook signature verification check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/razorpay-webhook-signature-verification/): Check Razorpay webhook handlers for missing X-Razorpay-Signature verification, HMAC over JSON.stringify(req.body) and == comparisons. Runs in your browser.
- [Razorpay payment signature verification check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/razorpay-payment-signature-verification/): Find Razorpay Checkout success handlers that mark orders paid without verifying razorpay_signature. Runs locally in your browser; your code never leaves it.
- [IDOR checker for Next.js API routes](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/idor-checker-nextjs/): Find Next.js, Express and FastAPI routes that load or delete records by an id from the request without checking the owner (IDOR / BOLA). Runs in your browser.
- [Next.js Server Actions authentication check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/server-actions-auth-check/): Find Next.js Server Actions with no authentication check. Every exported "use server" function is a public POST endpoint. Runs locally in your browser.
- [MCP server security scanner](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/mcp-server-security-scanner/): Scan MCP server source (Python or TypeScript) for shell commands, file paths, SQL and URLs built from tool input. Runs locally in your browser, no upload.
- [mcp.json config checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/mcp-json-config-checker/): Check .cursor/mcp.json, .mcp.json and claude_desktop_config.json for hard-coded secrets, npx -y without a version and filesystem servers given /. Runs locally.
- [.cursorrules hidden Unicode checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/cursorrules-hidden-unicode-checker/): Find invisible Unicode tag characters, bidi controls and zero-width characters hidden in .cursorrules, .cursor/rules and AGENTS.md, and decode them locally.
- [CLAUDE.md and agent settings security check](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/claude-md-security-check/): Check CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/settings.json for curl | sh, exfiltration, hidden instructions, bypassPermissions and auto-approved commands.
- [LLM API cost checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/llm-api-cost-checker/): Find LLM API calls with no max_tokens, no timeout, one call per item, uncached large prompts and retired models in Python and TypeScript. Runs in your browser.
- [Postgres migration lock checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/postgres-migration-lock-checker/): Find PostgreSQL migrations that lock busy tables: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY, constraints without NOT VALID, table rewrites, missing lock_timeout.
- [Postgres missing foreign key index checker](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/postgres-missing-foreign-key-index/): Find foreign key columns without an index in your PostgreSQL schema, migrations or schema.prisma. PostgreSQL does not create one for you. Runs in your browser.

## Optional

- [Spot the AI Attack](https://abhi12337.github.io/checks/spot-the-ai-attack/): a short browser game with real AI agent attack examples
